introduction: Are you ready to try a Cardi-rita? "Bongos" rapper Cardi B shares her favorite cocktail with Vogue.

vocabulary.definition: reviving or restoring strength, energy, or vigor
vocabulary.example: After a long day at work, I enjoy a refreshing glass of cold lemonade.

vocabulary.definition: full of energy and enthusiasm; bright and striking
vocabulary.example: The artist used vibrant colors to create a stunning painting.

vocabulary.definition: having a bold, unconventional, or unconventional quality
vocabulary.example: The new fashion collection has an edgy and modern aesthetic.

vocabulary.definition: showing a readiness to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected
vocabulary.example: She was generous with her compliments, always praising others' efforts.

vocabulary.definition: to burn or char something with a torch or flame; to heat or light with a torch
vocabulary.example: He torched the marshmallows over the campfire until they were golden brown.

vocabulary.definition: a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, typically away from home or work
vocabulary.example: They went on a tropical vacation to relax by the beach and enjoy the sunshine.
